name: Production particle-time-step convergence
purpose: Establish numerical convergence of the linked M0 force mover.
production_capability: Second-order Moon particle mover with SPICE force state.
configuration: Shadowed -3 lunar-radii fixture; 300 s; 15/30/60/120 steps; frozen force state.
independent_reference: 32768-step separate RK4 evaluator of the documented frozen-state ODE.
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred rotating LSO; ET/TDB state frozen for each diagnostic.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: One deterministic shadowed particle at four time-step levels.
procedure: Compare all four production endpoints to the independent reference and calculate ratios/orders.
acceptance_criteria: Errors strictly decrease; each ratio >=3; finest scaled state error <=1%.
expected_pass_result: The configured mover exhibits second-order convergence and meets the finest-state tolerance.
status_semantics: PASS qualifies the M0 temporal fixture only; AMR convergence remains I11-I13.
